revealed_content.statement: The current returns policy explicitly states a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claimed current 30-day window is supported.
revealed_content.plan: Extracted day counts from the bundled policy artifacts, compared the current v2 policy (30 days) to the claimed 30-day window, checked the stale base retrieval/judge reference (14 days), and verified the 10-day-old standard order against the current 30-day window; no event counts were present for an RR computation.
